messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick q — planning handwritten thank-you kits + small spot awards for Q2 recognition week. Need volunteers for addressing, packing, and a budget owner. Thoughts? :sparkles:
Ethan (People Ops): Love it. How many kits and who are recipients?
Maya (People Ops): ~120 kits: recent hires, onboarding buddies, and top nom picks. Budget estimate ~$600 (supplies + shipping + $5 e-gift for international).
Jules (Office Manager): I can order stationery + stickers. Supplies est ~$150. Also can print address labels.
Priya (Benefits): For international folks we should do e-gifts. Physical cards for US. Reminder: token policy < $100 is non-taxable, confirm per-country.
Sam (Eng): I can help pack evenings next week. Which days?
Lina (Hiring Ops): I have list of 35 recent hires + 20 mentors — will share CSV.
Maya (People Ops): Packing window: Tue/Wed 3/10-3/11 5–7pm (evening) + optional morning shift Wed 3/11 9–12. @Jules can you reserve Conf A?
Jules (Office Manager): Reserved Conf A for both slots. I'll add a supplies order: tape, tissue, envelopes, stickers.
Maya (People Ops): Sample CSV snippet for labels:
```
name,address,city,country,email
Ava Chen,123 Main St,San Francisco,US,ava@redwood.com
```
Maya (People Ops): Volunteers so far: @Sam, @Luis, @Priya — please confirm exact slots.
Luis (ML Eng): In for Tue evening. I can handle international e-gift sends.
Nora (People Ops Assistant): Can do morning shift Wed 9–12 and help with label printing beforehand.
Priya (Benefits): I'll coordinate e-gifts and confirm any tax notes. Budget owner? Maya you ok owning reconciliation?
Maya (People Ops): Yep I will own budget reconciliation and submit expense report. @Finance please confirm we can expense up to $700 under culture-events.
Finance Bot: Expense policy check: culture-events < $1000 requires manager approval. Approver: Maya. Manager on record: Priya. :white_check_mark:
Ethan (People Ops): Nomination winners list — deadline Fri 3/6. Maya can you post form link?
Maya (People Ops): Form link: https://forms.redwood.com/q2-thankyou (copy/paste)
Sam (Eng): Shipping labels — any preferred packing tape brand? low-waste options?
Jules (Office Manager): We use 'TapeCo Pro' in the supplies portal. Also eco boxes available, I can order smaller sizes to save shipping.
Maya (People Ops): Action items: Maya send sign-up + form today, Jules order supplies by EOD Thurs, Priya handles e-gifts, volunteers pack Tue/Wed. I'll post rota by Mon.
Lina (Hiring Ops): I'll drop recipient CSV in #secure-ops as requested and flag international addresses.
Maya (People Ops): Thanks team :heart: If anyone else wants to volunteer please react or DM me.
